name: model run 1
status: Written before the run. No model has answered this suite.
construct: Whether a model, shown each case's documents through the public view and asked for one structured answer, passes every hard gate of the case. It is not a measure of retrieval: the model is shown every document, so on the 11 cases whose corpus exceeds the retrieval budget it is not doing the task the reference agent does.

primary_metric.text: Per model, the number of the 42 cases passed in every one of the 3 trials, with an exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval. A case passes a trial only if the model returned a usable answer and the grader passed it. A refusal, an answer with no usable tool call, and a request that failed after its retry all count as failed.

secondary_metrics: any_trial: cases passed in at least one trial
spread: passes per trial, their range, and the number of cases whose verdict differs between trials
gates and by_mode: failures per gate and per failure mode, pooled over trials
over_refusal: answerable cases the model abstained on, per trial and pooled
budget_bound and not_budget_bound: the primary metric on the 11 cases whose corpus exceeds the budget and on the other 31
statuses, tokens and usd per model

primary.tests: Each model's all_trials verdict per case against the reference agent, and against overlap-document, the copy-one-document agent with the most passes at seed 2026 (14 of 42; the reference agent passes 9). Exact two-sided McNemar on the 42 paired cases.

between_models.tests: Every two models, all_trials verdict per case, exact two-sided McNemar.
between_models.correction: Holm over the 3 tests, on its own

decision_rule: A model is said to differ from a baseline, or from another model, only when the Holm-adjusted p of that test is below alpha. Anything else is reported as no difference found, not as equivalence.
power_note: With 42 cases the primary family needs 8 discordant cases in one direction and none in the other for its smallest test to reach a Holm-adjusted p below 0.05 (2 * 0.5^8 * 6 = 0.047). Smaller differences will read as no difference found.
withheld_when: any setting above differs from the run (models, trials, seed, effort, max_tokens, max_attempts, prompt, grader version, dataset version, or which surface agent is best)
the run is incomplete: the spending cap or a rejected request stopped it before every model finished every trial
more than max_share_errors of a model's cases ended in a request error
not_registered: Scores (citation precision and recall, retrieval recall, faithfulness), per-tier pass rates, and any comparison not listed above are exploratory.
